evidence.name: Screen field: Fill behind the input
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Fill behind the input" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Fill behind the input
sections.description: Sets the fill color inside the input box. Most funnels leave it clear so the screen background shows through, or use a subtle light fill to make the tappable field stand out. Just make sure it contrasts with the typed-text color so answers stay easy to read and people don't abandon the question.
